summary: Bump the Foundry module to 0.3.9 so Forge receives the viewport-accurate diagnostics and artifact point picker.

checks.name: Manifest version
checks.run: node -e "const m=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('module.json','utf8')); if(m.version!=='0.3.9') throw new Error('expected module 0.3.9');"

checks.name: Diagnostics assets remain packaged by recursive module release copies
checks.run: test -f scripts/scene-diagnostics.mjs && test -f templates/scene-library.hbs && test -f styles/scene-library.css
